title: Perfect!
content: I got this app free through Starbucks so many years ago and have used it religiously since. I love that we can make our own white noise sound mixes!

title: Stopped working-Sleepless in Seattle
content: Irritating app. Only worked for a few nights. I can’t even get it. to play any sounds. Aggravating!  It’s a dead duck in the water. Complete waste of time and money.

title: Can’t sleep without! ⛈️
content: I got this app years ago maybe over a decade ago through Starbucks when they used to sponsor Apps in little business cards with a code. Over a decade later I still use it every single night before I go to sleep. My most used and most loved app I’ve ever had. The interface still looks sleek and very modern for how old this app is. Couldn’t recommend it enough!

title: Okay
content: I used this layered over the sounds of the Rain Rain app and together these two block out all sound while I sleep. I think this app could benefit from more sounds. I’d really like to see the library extended. The sounds they do have do a good job of masking for the most part, but with more sound options it would be more effective

title: Love love love
content: I love Noisli. I’ve used it for years. The ability to make my own ambient sound track is amazing. My favorite tracks are “Outdoor Cafes” for day (birds and a breeze) and night (cicadas and a fire). <3

title: Cannot set timer!
content:
Sounds are too soft
Want a refund!!!

title: Love the simplicity
content: Love the simplicity of this app and the way yycanl layer sounds in. The sound choices are excellent and each one has just the right balance of sounding like blurry white noise and distinctive sounds. I love the changing color background. Also love that there's a fade out timer.

title: So simple and helpful!
content: I love this app! So easy to use and customizable. It’s amazing. Just want to ask.. please add AirPlay, that would be so nice!

title: Scam, don’t pay
content: Total scam! Paid for the Pro plan, but it’s worse than the free version. They denied the problem and refused a refund. Save your money!

title: Won’t output sound to another device such as an Apple HomePod
content: App seems ok- provided you only want the sound from your phone. If you want to send it to something like a HomePod there isn’t an obvious way to do so in the app, and it doesn’t work by holding the phone near the device to transfer the sound. Wasted $1.99.

title: Please update
content: Please update to be fully supported my latest devices

title: How to sign up for the pro membership?
content: I love this app and use it all the time, however I can’t find an option to upgrade to the pro membership for more sounds within the app.

title: Wonderful
content: I am so grateful for this app. The fact that it is ad free and so simple to use is such a breathe of fresh air. I love making sound combos. Noisli allows you to become a soundscaper. I can transport myself to the autumn sounds near my childhood home, camping, or a laying around in a hot apartment with a loved one with a few simple taps. Thank you Noisli for bringing me better sleep and endless nostalgia!

title: Unimpressed
content: For an app I paid for, I expected a lot more sound options. The brightly colored background is jarring , I would prefer a dark mode. I don’t think I’ll use the app much.

title: BEST SLEEP/STUDY APP EVER!!
content: I’ve had this app for such a long time now i cant remember when i found out about it. I have it on my phone my computer and its a must. I must say that the developers did a very good job props to you!!!

title: Good but Old
content: New user of Noisli. I think this app has great use, sounds are good, simple design (which not a lot of sleep sound apps have a clean design). The only thing is that I wish they would update the platform. It does not fit the newer models of iPhones. I hope they update this.

title: Add “brown “ noise”. 🙏🏽
content:
Love the app…..👍

Please add “brown “ noise.”

Thanks

title: No tricks. It’s just … peaceful.
content:
I love this app. I leave reviews all the time. Good, bad, indifferent and most of the bad reviews revolve around the app not living up to what it promised or, hidden fees. 

 There are some sound elements that could be enhanced, but that doesn’t throw a speck of dust on the fact that Noisli is simple, easy to use and surprisingly spontaneously awesome. It’s playing in the background as I write this review. 

To the Devs: Thank you!

Future Update Suggestions: please improve the ocean sounds / the ocean seems frenetic and it is anything but frenetic. Good ocean = 😍

title: Great App But Want Ocean Sounds
content: I’ll add a fifth star when ocean sounds are added. Otherwise, I still use it all the time.

title: Calming rain
content: I got this app free from a Starbucks promotion many years ago.  My favorite is the gentle rain sound (without the thunder).  It’s so calming that I use it when reading, or doing art, or meditating.

title: Great for not being aware of your neighbors
content: By far the best background noise app, especially when coupled with noise canceling headphones and earplugs. Very useful for not hearing your lovely neighbors who love partying 24/7 and who love training their dogs to bark at nothing by giving them treats when they bark at nothing.

title: Please adjust app size for iPhone 12 Pro Max
content: The app does what it says, but the user interface is not adjusted for the big screen of my iPhone 12 Pro Max and it looks like if it’s running on a smaller screen.

title: App crashes on launch every time
content: What a bummer. This app just crashes on launch every time.

title: doesn’t work
content: App is no longer functional, will not open at all.

title: App crashes
content:
Edit: After deleting and reinstalling the app, Noisli regained its functionality. I’ve also changed my rating from one to five stars. 

Since updating my iOS, the app no longer functions as others have said. I enjoyed  the app on an almost nightly basis, in order to help me fall asleep, for 5 years. I hope there’s an update soon. If there’s an update, I’ll change my rating to reflect the app’s current functionality.

title: Please fix iOS 14.2 bug/crash!
content: After updating to iOS 14.2, the app immediately crashes within a second of opening each time. Please fix and push an update, I rely on this app for my sanity so much! 💙

title: Crashes with iOS 14.2
content:
App hasn’t been updated in three years and now it’s crashing on launch 100% of the time on my iPhone XS since upgrading to iOS 14.2. I don’t expect it to be fixed. 

Before that, app worked just fine. I could hear the seams in the loops now and then, but loops were long enough that it wasn’t a huge issue. The white/pink/blue noise worked well to help with my tinnitus.

title: Good but shoulda saved the $2
content: App is nice but I should have saved the two dollars and instead used the desktop web version which offers additional features and is entirely free.

title: Excellent
content: I love this app. Been using Noisli for years, it really helps me focus on work.

title: Needs an update
content: I like the sounds this includes, but the app needs some updates. Being able to start/stop them via the button on my headphones would be great.

title: Great app! But I’m curious.
content: I love this app. It’s perfect for when I need to focus or relax by blocking things out. But I am curious... sometimes I feel like I hear very, very, very faint string music behind the sounds. Is that there? Am I hearing things?

title: Great for focus, no shortcut to play on secondary devices
content: Love this app! I had used the chrome extension and liked that but think it is worth the small fee to have this available when I’m not connected to WiFi and have chrome open. I do wish it had a shortcut to play on external Bluetooth speakers, like google home/Sonos/etc.

title: Basic but neat
content: Simple functional app. Wish it had airplay support, though...

title: Free apps that do the same thing
content: Didn’t see the big deal.  There are plenty of free apps out there that offer sounds.  I paid for the app and was given a few sounds.  However, you have to subscribe to get features and full accessibility.  Not worth it.  Regret paying for the app.

title: Amazing app yet this app needs app blocker
content:
I am impressed how simple this app to use. Not like other applications this is far more simpler to use, you do not need an account to sign up, all you need is to pay for the app which is not  too expensive. I’m not big fan of subscriptions because other developers is making others pay per month. Why not per year? 
People has to continue working to make money. 

Also as for your extension, I was kind of feeling disappointed because you’re doing subscriptions too, as long you are not demanding for money. For the rational reason I think your doing this to keep your applications from having any problems, especially from us customers using your app. 

As customer of these applications, instead of pressuring the developers to push themselves to work hard. Work smart than hard because it will be difficult to tackle onto difficult tasks, although I suggest breaking down the difficult tasks into steps to complete a harder task to improve this application. 

One more thing before I go. Do you mind adding an app blocker to keep myself and others from being distracted? Since social media, and the internet is source of my distractions I’m mostly on my iPad than my laptop. I think it would be smart if you add an app blocker, since I already paid for this when I got the app. Could you add the app blocker for people who already paid for the app?

title: Not consistent
content: The worst part about this app is that it does not resume after anything else happens on my iPhone. Apple Music always does but this does not. It’s super annoying to have to go back into this app and restart over and over. Developers need to change this. Otherwise the app is great.

title: great, easy app
content: Had this app A few years ago and somehow lost it, tried multiple other apps in that time, but nothing else really compared. Re-downloaded, and still loving it! Only thing that helps me sleep, and i love the save custom sounds feature.

title: Surpassed my expectations
content: I find this app to have a functional simplicity that’s refreshing. The sound is clear and realistic, to me, and I hear neither a break nor jump in each sound loop cycle.

title: Needs improvement
content: The app is easy to use. The sounds are great and definitely relaxing. The background changes color on its own to pale colors meanwhile the text is white. This makes it very hard to see. The app uses very thin fonts that don’t adhere to Apple accessibility standards so the text is hard to read. I would prefer that we are able to select a static background color instead of it changing all the time. Pale mint color on white text basically makes the text disappear.

title: Casting/Streaming
content: Being able to cast to smart devices would be nice.

title: Great app but...
content: Still looking for that perfect sound. Please keep adding what you can

title: Pretty good, not great
content: This app is very user friendly, I love that you can make your own combos, its cute and simple, However, the sample tracks are just ok, I wish there were a few more and some need to be improved. Saving a combo is not super clear and I accidentally deleted a few before I figured it out. Also I love the timer, I wish there was an alarm option at the end of the timer, to wake up after or simply dift into silence.

title: Almost perfect
content: I use the app every night. It’s is calming and I love the sound combos. My only complaint is when the colors change on the screen sometimes it is impossible to see the timer etc.

title: Hands down the best
content: Love this app have used it for years nothing comes close not even the newer ones.

title: Is this app still supported?
content:
App works as intended, but is still not updated for the new screen format of the iPhone X and beyond. 

Is this app still supported? The last update was years ago. 

I can’t make a recommendation to get this app unless it will be maintained at the very minimum to support new screen formats.

title: Great app! But slightly outdated
content: Support for new devices such as iPhone X and newer would be great!

title: Great and simple but....
content: I love everything about this app, but it seems to interfere with my morning Alarms if it happens to still be playing when my alarm is set to go off.

title: No HomePod Support
content: Thoroughly disappointing to have paid for this and afterwards learn it does not have wifi output support. Perhaps it’s more difficult than I think to build in that functionality, but come on!

title: Please update
content:
Very nice looking app, that gets the job done. 

Please update this app to fit the screens of the X style notched phones. It’s not great paying for an app that is not kept up to date.

title: A suggestion
content: Please add an airplane cabin noise! That would be awesome!

title: Please allow landscape orientation
content: I love this app and I use it for hours everyday while studying. I wouldn’t change anything about it except for the fact that it always locks in the portrait orientation, even when my iPad is in the Keyboard folio. It’s annoying because then all my apps are stuck into that orientation as well, so I need to flip them around.

title: Love It!
content: It’s very simple but for $1.99, well worth it! I have tinnitus and when I don’t consciously try to ignore it, it can really be irritating. Using this app while reading, internet searching, before I go to sleep, whatever, really helps.

title: Best Sleep App I’ve Used!
content: The sound quality is GREAT! When hooked up to a good speaker, the sounds REALLY come alive! Definitely worth buying!

title: Please Please Please
content: Please release an update accommodating to users with larger phones, i have an iphone x and i love the look and design of this app but it doesn’t fit my screen, not a problem as i don’t stay on the app, but cmon

title: Please keep going
content:
This is one of my favorite apps and the quality of the sounds as well as the mixer/combo functions are amazing. I would love to see more sounds added over time to make more combos and to keep a good variety going as my mood for sounds changes quite a bit.

As a number of friends also use this app it would be great to have a function that allows the sharing an syncing of combos to other accounts.

Keep up the great work!

title: Tinnitus life saver!
content: This is by far the best sound app I’ve ever tried. Based on the fact that I can now sit and read without a tv or some other sound on to drown out my ears ringing, this is well worth the couple bucks it costs

title: Fix the rain track!!
content: I’m a super light sleeper and white noise is what I need to sleep. The rain track is perfect but only for a few minutes. Then a random violin track starts playing in the background??! Get RID OF THE VIOLIN. It’s maddening! Make it just rain and this app would be great! Ugh.

title: No longer works
content: Broken, don’t bother downloading. This hasn’t been update to the latest iOS (v12), and now has a consistent lag when using. About every 30s or so audio drops out, making it unusable.

title: Needs music support
content: This app is great, but it would be perfect if you could play music at the same time as listening to the white noise.

title: Great, just a couple nitpicks
content: Wish there was landscape on iPad and it was updated for iPhone X dimensions.

title: Not bad but a bit dated
content: Love the sounds and the simple interface. However the app hasn't been updated since 2015 and doesn't feature as many sounds I hoped for. Plus there is no landscape mode for the iPad, which is a big let down.

title: Almost there
content: I’m quite pleased with this well designed app and it’s meditative nature sounds except for the thunder sound which is not realistic sounding and the fact that the app stops playing if you try to add some background music from iTunes, Pandora or other music player apps. Simultaneously playing two separate sound apps together technically IS possible on an iOS device as other ambiance apps can do it or they have an “add background music” feature (the Coffitivity coffee shop app can do both) —  so it somewhat disappointed me to discover that Noisli could do neither. Add that feature guys and improve the thunder sounds and I’ll give you 5 stars!

title: Helpful, with audio issues
content:
A very helpful app for drowning out the noise from an open office format. 

There seem to be a few audio tracks that have other noises in them. I believe the rain or thunder tracks have violin (or something) notes in the background. 

Just an example, but fixing this would be helpful. This issue snaps me out of focus every time, which seems to be about every 15 minutes or so.

title: Pretty good but this is worth noting...
content: I only use the rain sound, but there’s this strange, ambient noise in the background. It’s faint, but I notice it every time. It sounds like a synth or something, and it goes from one note to another, a whole step apart. I find it pretty distracting, but it’s not a big deal. I still really like the app, but if you like rain noise like me, I’d just use a YouTube video because this faint noise is strange.

title: Love it but would love Sonos support!
content: This is my favorite white noise app, but having just got Sonos speakers, I would love if I could play Noisli over them.

title: More sounds please
content:
I’ve used this app nightly for over a year. My husband and I love it! 

I wish there were some new sounds added. I would love a heartbeat/baby uterine heartbeat sound. Those are such comfy and loving sounds to me. But even still I’ll continue to use this app.

title: Works great, except...
content: I've tried many apps to help me fall asleep and this is by far the best. The sounds are not repetitive and making combonations is fantastic.  My only reason for not giving this five stars is that as the background changes colors (which is really well done) the font and icons are *really* hard to see. That change would make this app perfect.

title: Needs Landscape.
content: It’s ok, does what it does pretty well, but an app that has put work into an aesthetically pleasing experience shouldn’t make me flip my iPad whenever I want to use it. It’s actually getting pretty frustrating.

title: Love this app!
content: I see a lot of people complaining about the simplicity of this app but I think that’s part of the reason why it’s so great! Transitioning from a fan in the summer to no noise is always hard for me so I found this app and now I fall asleep to a crackling fire and wind blowing. I’ve even recommended it to all my friends. Love it!

title: needs a bit more work
content: this is a nice simple app. so why can’t it display in landscape mode on the ipad? it does change its layout for the bigger screen but rotates to portrait mode. hopefully the developer will fix this.

title: I wouldn’t have graduated without this
content: This drowns out noise without being distracting. I think I got this for free through Starbucks about four years ago, and I’ve installed it on all my phones since. I love you, Noisli.

title: I love it!!
content: I’m the primary babysitter for my month old nephew and he LOVES the noises on this app! And I love them too! We go to sleep to this app every time TOTALLY WORTH THE MONEY!

title: Airplay
content: Hey guys how about adding Airplay so sounds can be used with other devices?

title: It’s ok.
content: Looks very nice. That said, I’ll keep using an “ugly but more functional” white noise app until at least a couple of things are changed. Most importantly, allow for other audio to play (eg. Audible) while the white noise is on. I’d also like to see landscape on the iPad. Doesn’t seem like a big deal but when all your other apps are landscape and then you have to flip for this...it’s frustrating.

title: Needs to be louder
content: The max volume should be raised, I can barely hear it when I’m just using my phone’s speakers.

title: Sorry, false advertising!
content: Just bought this app specifically because the description claims it supports background audio. It does not. Booooo.

title: Well designed app that lacks updates and active development
content:
My ideal app would provide me a passive soundscape I can easily work to. If I could mix this app’s design with Coffitivity’s function, that would be what I’m looking for.  

The app is beautiful and wonderfully designed. However, there is little development on this app with no updates or  new version in over a year. But for 1.99, most people will be satisfied with the app as is.

title: Browser is best, then android, then ios
content:
I got Noisli as the Chrome extension. It was great. 5/5 stars. So I paid for it.

Then I got it for Android and paid for it again. It was fine but didn’t take advantage of the OS (there’s no “playing” notification so you can’t easily turn it up or down or find it like every other sound making app). Fine, 3/5 stars.

Then I paid for it on ios. It has an ipad app but it doesn’t align horizontally. The max 6 combos is immediately apparent (why limit it?). It’s small stuff but it amounts to a lousy experience when I’m writing.

Taken that I’ve paid 3 times for this app, 2 stars seems fair.

title: Air Pod Incompatible?
content: I didn’t think this was even possible, but Noisli just refuses to work with my Air Pods. I have an iPhone 6s+ and have been using Noisli for years and loving it but for some reason I get no audio output when using my Air Pods. I’d love to rate higher, and other headphones work well, but for some reason Noisli just doesn’t want to output to my Air Pods.

title: Almost
content:
Only needs an update for the X.
I had trouble figuring out how to set a custom timer until I realized it is programmed like a scroll wheel. Slide up or down on the time and set to your liking.

title: What I needed
content: This is the most beautiful app, and had everything I need when I was looking for an app with natural sounds.

title: Needs “Mix with other apps” feature
content: Would have given a five star but I really expected a simple feature as this one to be available. An update with this feature included would be appreciated. For ref. check the app called Binaural on the App Store, I can play music and use the binaural beats app at the same time.

title: Simple and delightful
content: My new go-to app for comforting background sounds while I work. Good job developers

title: Unable to use with Spotify
content: I cannot use the app while using Spotify, is there any setting for that? Or it doesn’t work at all?

title: Timer Issues
content: Love the app, but the timer needs to be customizable! Sometimes it says 25 min, sometimes it says 1. I’d like to set it myself!

title: Use it all the time
content: Especially in the office and on airplanes. Also my wife uses it to sleep sometimes. Great app!

title: Good but not perfect
content: It’s a great app and you should definitely get it, but it’s not optimized for an 8+ yet, the resolution is way off

title: Creative Solution!
content: After seeing this app featured in an article, I decided to try it. I’ve used it consistently for 2 weeks now, and I have seen a noticeable difference in how easy it is to fall asleep to the soothing sounds. I feel like the app is basic, and it could have some more sounds and features. It has room to grow, but it is still very usable.

title: Frog sounds
content: It’s an awesome app but they could improve by adding frog sounds at night. If they did it would be a solid 5 stars!

title: Overpriced
content: It is a great concept but not a whole lot of bang for your buck. The app simply combines sounds to make a soothing experience to help you work or sleep. It would be nice if there was an alarm function in addition to the off timer

title: It's good
content: It's good

title: Needs External Audio Compatibility
content: This is such a great white noise app! All it needs is to be compatible with external audio (i.e. Listen to music with a noisili combo in the background)

title: Timer modification
content: I was introduced to Noisli as a (free) Chrome extension and love it primarily for the ability to set the timer to any amount of time I want. I was excited to find this iOS counterpart and didn't hesitate to pay $1.99 because my iPhone is where I would use the timer most, whereas my laptop is where I would use the white noise most. I expected this pay version to have at least the same features I got from the free app. BUYER BEWARE! It turns out this iOS app does not have a customizable timer and now I have paid for an app that doesn't do as much as its free version.

title: Will not allow other audio to play simultaneously
content: I was looking for white noise to play along with podcasts to block out noisy neighbors. When you open this app it turns off other audio

title: Retina display resolution please
content: Please update it to retina display

title: Excellent ! Needs more sound packs
content:
Use it to sleep every night via a Bluetooth speaker system - perhaps add more sounds & sound variations 😉

P.S. THANK YOU for finally adding the ability for, it to play with other audio apps to mix things up more ! Now, I'll use it every single night 👍

title: Need updates
content:
***2017 and no updated sounds or quality: uhhh? This app has become a 255+ MB space waster on my phone. Actual good updates ever to be in the works? It's boring!!!***

It's good but needs work.

1. I wish it didn't take up so much space.

2. Also, it needs some more choices on sounds, like ZzzZzz offers. Wind chimes and monk chant would be great. That one is a Noisli ripoff, but with more options.

I like this app, but it's really limited and needs more options. Until then...deleted.

title: Great for work!!!
content:
I'm a software developer and need to concentrate. My coworkers are very loud and noisy. This app has been a life saver for me. I love how you can mix different ambient sounds with white noise and control how loud each one plays. 

Having this has allowed me to focus on my code and not feel like screaming at people. 

Definitely a must get if you're trying to drown out noise and concentrate.

title: Great app missing Web features
content: Since I bought the app I expect all the features to be in there from the Web service. There are no random productivity and relaxation mixes for which I primarily bought it. Nevertheless a good app please make the update. Also the interface I don't find it standard. Thank you for your attention.

title: App Not quite right
content: Love noisli and the app does work. Unfortunately it doesn't register with iOS as media though so no way to pause outside app and doesn't respond appropriately to other iOS events. Being able to pause would be very nice and is something I expect from a paid app.

title: Intelligently designed app
content: Love this service, great sounds, good to mix, easy to use. Wish they had a Mac version.

title: Simple
content: This is the original. Campfire and Fan are best in class and I owe many restful nights to this app.

title: Noisli is the best
content: Before I found Noisli, I was trying to stream 8-hour laggy youtube videos of fan/white noise. This app solves all my problems. It really is hard to sleep when the silence is so... Loud. So this really helps. Thanks Noisli team.

title: Great for Deep Work
content: As a programmer I'm constantly in need of a way to reduce distractions around me. This app does that perfectly. Worth every penny.

title: Love this app!
content: I use it to fall asleep and it works wonders.

title: Does exactly what it says it will do
content: The app simply works perfectly.

title: i love it, but...
content: There is a noticeable gap in the brown noise loop.  Please fix in the update.

title: I never write reviews, but...
content: This app seriously has changed my life. That might sound dramatic for a simple noise-maker app, but it's true. I'm a CIT student and I have to study pretty much every free second of every day, and I live in a loud environment that doesn't always lend itself well to that. This app is amazing for creating a soothing environment when you're trying to drown out the noise. I used to listen to instrumental music when I studied because lyrics can be distracting, but if you truly want to zone out to what you're doing Noisli is so much better for that. I find myself totally in my own world to this app and coming back to myself after a nice long study session and realizing Noisli is still going, pretty much forgetting about it because it was working so well, is really what it's designed for. As odd as it sounds, you won't even realize it's doing it's job. Just recently, too, I started sleeping with the fan/wind combo going instead of keeping my ceiling fan on all night (because it's getting cold) and it works very well for that too. Totally keeps the dogs from waking me up across the house. I can't recommend this app enough, you HAVE to try it to understand.

title: Disappointed for sure
content: I wanted to buy an app to help me sleep when I'm traveling because I'm a super light sleeper and I sleep with a box fan at home to help me sleep better. Got this app because it had the fan option, however the fan is beyond quiet and would never be able to block out noises for me to sleep well... Glad the thunderstorm is loud, though! Still very disappointed about the fan...

title: Still no random option?
content: You folks are amazing, so I must be missing something. Please add the Random button to the mobile app. I use it constantly on desktop and I wish I could get it with the paid app.

title: Very useful
content: I've used Noisil in a cubicle area, for meditation, and to block out/neutralize other sound. For noise blocking the brown noise is very effective (volume adjusted to blend) when layered in with other sounds. The rain, water droplet and thunderstorm are great when combined too. Thanks so much for this app! It's a tool I'm glad I can count on.

title: Migraine Helper
content: As a young adult who has and continues to suffer from migraines, I find this app incredibly useful as background music when I want to pass the time in bed or try to sleep while dealing with her headaches. thanks Noisli!

title: Love it... But.
content: I love this app I've been looking for it since I got a new phone and just got it again, it's bummer they haven't updated it in two years though it could really use some new noises

title: Great noise filter for work
content: I love this app for the noise combinations and sounds - i use it particularly for filtering out sound when trying to concentrate and coworkers talk around me. Pretty easy to use. Only reason why 4 stars is maybe 1 time out of 20 you can't really flip among the screens, and the app size is especially big for what it is, but on the other end the sounds feel pretty high quality.

title: Helps me fall asleep
content: I love this app because you can choose the mix of noises that fit your needs. And you can save your combinations!

title: Don't sign in
content: My app is now 100% non functioning and my custom setups are gone. I can't get in. My app is dead.

title: Best sound app
content: I love this app, and I like how you can combine sounds. I play the rain+thunder sounds to go to sleep or when I read. The interface is simple and easy to use.

title: Makes for a relaxing work environment
content: I don't like all of the sounds, but the ones I do like I really like.

title: Some annoying things
content:
The loops are quite short. So you hear the loud female cackle in the coffee shop a lot. Stays with you. 

It's been two years, but they still haven't bothered flipping the switch that would optimize it for iPhone 6 Plus or 6s Plus.

title: Love!
content: I have tinnitus and use this app to sleep every night. Absolutely love it and love that it works offline too when I'm out of town.

title: Very relaxing
content: I use this app to go to sleep. It works in my dogs too. Helps distract from any outside noises.

title: iPhone 6 screen support would be nice
content: I mean, it's been almost 2 years, right? Still scaled graphics.

title: Well designed, with one big flaw
content: A fantastic, cleanly designed app in every way but one huge one: it needs to pause/stop the noise when the headphone jack is unplugged. Compared to most iPhone audio that stops automatically when you (purposely or accidentally) unplug, Noisli keeps playing loudly until you go through the clumsy steps of unlocking your phone, opening the app, and stopping the sound manually. At best it's inconvenient, at worst it can be very embarassing to unplug and blast a quiet room or train car with loud noise from your phone.

title: Misophonia Must-Have!
content: As someone with misophonia, I use this app every night to drown out miscellaneous sounds from my apartment complex. I like the fan sound, and the rain.

title: Almost as good as the web version
content: I really like the app for productivity. However, the app is lacking in a key feature that I love on the web version which is the preset sounds for relaxation, productivity or random. Please bring these features over to the app and it will be perfect.

title: Engine sound crept in?
content:
I was listening to the creek sound and I hear engine noises in the back. 
You would think they could put a creek sounds that does not have cars passing by in the background. 

Interface is great. 
But being a noise app, the noises should be clean and free from background noises of cars passing by. Please change the creek sound.

title: Almost Perfect

I do wish it had the addition like the online version for premade productive, relax, or random sound combinations. I like just clicking them and the combinations being given and if I want a new one I just click it again.

title: i love it

title: Great sounds.
content:
I really like your app. I think the white noise volume doesn't adjust low enough I believe that it's a bit too loud even at low volume. That is why I prefer the fan noise. 

A great noise that should be added should be a ticking clock to build up pressure to stay focused and get whatever it is done.

title: Awesome sounds--glitchy app
content: I love the ability to create my own combinations of sounds. The app is very pretty and simple--which I like--but it constantly is glitching out. 1. Sometimes the drag bars below each sound don't move or a second one appears and 2. sometimes when I create a combo it freezes and you can't create another one unless you restart the app. If the developers fix these bugs I would give 5 stars hands down!

title: Great noise generator, glitchy app.
content:
I love the sound that the app produces and the ability to easily mix sounds. Unlike some other generators I’ve tried, it doesn’t obviously loop within a few seconds.

The UI would be clean and good if it worked well. -2 stars for all the UI glitches. Volume sliders frequently don’t disappear when toggling sounds off. Sometimes multiple sliders are rendered under a sound that isn’t playing. Multiple lines of text are rendered on top of one another when adding a preset. It’s not a complete deal breaker but feels very sloppy. I often find myself killing it and restarting it to get it into the state I want.

title: Works great! Even has a timer.
content: Love it and love the timer. Lots of sound options.

title: Great app, could use a few more sounds
content: Great for taking naps. I have no complaints about this app, but more sounds would be great. Also, please add train whistles to the train tracks sound or add a train whistle we could play over it.

title: Baby Tested and Approved
content: I downloaded this app before for some ambient noise of myself to relax.  Last week, my little nephew who is only three months came over and was getting fussy.  I turned on the computer and used the online app.  My sis-in-law was amazed because it knocked out my nephew within minutes.  She downloaded it herself and says it works like a charm when my nephew needs to take a nap and it’s better than the white noise machine they bought to calm him.  I also say it’s a better buy because you can take it with you when you go to a place where you can’t take a white noise machine.  So, thanks for making such a great app that gives my nephew sweet dreams.

title: Great for productivity
content:
Started using this in my home office to give me a little bit of ambient noise. I have found it much easier to concentrate and quite enjoy the ability to change up the noise, add in different sounds etc. Super easy app to use.

One improvement would be the ability to pause the sounds through the native iOS sound controls. For example you cannot pause the sounds by sliding up from the bottom of your home screen. IOS does not recognize that the app is actually playing sounds. So you cannot pause from here.

content:

title: Must-have!

title: It's ok.

title: Good option for customizable ambient noise.
content:
Noisli provides an array of 16 decent-quality audio samples of nature, generated noise, and a couple of other choices to suit specific tastes (including a travelling train, a traditional electric fan, a coffee shop, and a fireplace).

The good: multiple sounds can be activated at once and individually balanced.  (A little wind with your gentle stream?)  Once that's done, you can switch apps and let that carry on.  If you don't, the clean interface phases gently between hues.  Customizations can be saved and recalled.

A couple of complaints: no landscape mode – an inconvenience for those who use an iPhone or iPad stand.  More than once, I've had a second volume slider appear (at a different displayed level) directly on top of the already visible one.  In short, the interface isn't polished to a shine.

title: Nice app but buggy
content:
For a simple app it is slightly buggy. When I play my existing prerecorded combo I get multiple dots on the volume lines. Some sounds are not being played but the volume dots for these are on the farthest left regardless so I get confused as to which sounds are actually playing. 

Please update it to:
1) Have landscape orientation on iPad
2) Ability to edit existing prerecorded combo sounds
3) Make user interface a little less mysterious

title: iOS 7.1 and Later ONLY
content: Take note that this app only runs on iOS 7.1 and later. That surprised me, since I thought anything this simple would work with earlier versions, including iOS 5 on my 3gs.. That’s the reason for the four stars. As far as I know the app works fine otherwise. Note too the huge size, over 250 MB. If Apple allows them to remove some of the sounds, that’d be a handy enhancement for those short of storage.
